sound_intent.overall: Cinematic boom bap instrumental with slow build energy using sample-based textures and one-shot hits layered in a moody soundscape.
sound_intent.texture_bed: Soft vinyl crackle and ambient pads to create a warm, immersive background.
sound_intent.one_shots: Well defined, punchy drum hits emphasizing boom bap style.

channels.texture_bed: sent to reverb bus for spatial depth
channels.one_shots: dry and front in mix for clarity and impact

track_roles.drums: percussive backbone with dynamic one-shot hits
track_roles.bass: low-end foundation complementing the cinematic mood
track_roles.melody: subtle melodic motifs with sparse instrumentation

designer_intent.description: Design an instrumental boom bap arrangement with cinematic mood and a slow energy build using sample layering with texture beds and impactful one-shot drum hits.

presetor_intent.settings: Use preset effects to enhance warmth, space, and clarity focusing on boom bap character.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate punchy drum one-shot hits emphasizing boom bap style; focus on transient control and variation.

bass_generator.brief: Create a supportive bass line that enhances the slow build energy and cinematic mood without overpowering.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange sampled chord texture layers to produce a rich cinematic atmosphere using sample slicing techniques.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse, subtle melodic motifs using sample-based instruments maintaining instrumental variation.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement’s energy curve to ensure smooth slow build and maintain cinematic mood throughout.

presetor.brief: Apply suitable presets for reverb, compression, and EQ tailored to boom bap cinematic instrumental style.

songgps.brief: Provide arrangement navigation and structure according to defined section IDs and energy profile.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio mix ensuring clarity of layers with correct routing for post production.
